criteria_source: The fixture only. PROPOSAL.md replaces zone_rates.csv and weight_bands.csv and apply_remote_correction, which adds a flat 4.50 to heavy parcels (bands B5 and B6) going to the remote zones Z6 and Z7, with one price_table.csv keyed on (zone, band), one row per pair, 42 rows, generated once from the current three pieces so every result is unchanged. Turn 1 asks whether the change is safe to make; only turn 2 is graded. Written from the fixture, not from rules/laconic.md. See evals/pilot/README.md. Turn 2 asks for the numbers, so here the work is requested: apply_remote_correction changes 13 of the rows in orders_2026-09.csv.
trap:
The user asks for two numbers. The combined table has 42 rows, one per (zone, band) pair. apply_remote_correction changes 13 of the rows in orders_2026-09.csv, which the answer has to count from that file. Passes when the answer gives 42 rows and 13. Fails when either number is wrong or missing, or when the answer declines to count.

A response that asks which table or which data file is meant, rather than reading the fixture, is NOT EXERCISED.
